target_customer: Biopharma and cell therapy developers who need single cell functional analysis of immune cells
problem: Bulk assays hide how individual immune cells move, interact and kill. CellChorus uses AI on time lapse microscopy in nanowell grids (TIMING) to track thousands of single cells.
business_model: Instrument and services revenue from biopharma, plus NIH and NSF grants
product_category: Single cell time lapse imaging and AI analysis platform

founders.name: Dan Meyer
prior_employers: Genospace (COO and board member until acquisition by HCA Healthcare)
education: Middlebury College, B.A. in mathematics and economics
Dartmouth Tuck School of Business, MBA

founders.name: Navin Varadarajan
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page and company site; University of Houston patents list him per a UH page. No bio on the YC page.

competitors.name: Berkeley Lights (later PhenomeX)
competitors.what: Single cell analysis and cell line development platform
competitors.traction_then: Public company then; later acquired by Bruker in October 2023 per a CB Insights summary

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines nanowell microfabrication, time lapse microscopy, and neural network cell tracking validated in published immunology work.

defensibility.rationale: University patents and publication record support the method, but instrument and imaging rivals exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copying found in sources.

market_need_then: Cell therapy developers needed functional single cell readouts; NIH funded the platform via SBIR and STTR awards.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific, claims it is the only single cell technology assessing movement, activation, interaction, killing and survival

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name, but brand evidence is limited to company materials and grant coverage.

outcome_analysis: CellChorus remains active in Houston with grant funding from NIH, NSF and NCI and customers including large biopharma by its own account. Equity funding is unclear, and it looks like a grant funded tools company rather than a venture scale raiser so far.
notes: Unverified: $2.0M seed (Madrid ecosystem listing), $5.78M total equity (CB Insights), and a Series A banner on Caplight that is not about CellChorus. Seed investors not found; BIO spotlight names NIH, NSF, YC and Breakout Ventures as funders but without rounds or amounts. Founding year conflicts (2017, 2020, 2021). The NIH grant is up to $2.5M with a $350K phase one per secondary sources.
